groups.status: TbuE issuing identity closed; F/G/I/H and whole operon named-only

limits: 1996 tbuW physiological contribution remained under investigation; ferredoxin-like sequence does not prove repair mechanism.
Promoter candidates have consensus/spacing discrepancies; direct TbuS or ANR binding is unproved. NCBI putative binding feature says bound moiety unknown.
U20258.1 current tbuW ATG225 differs paper transcript-map numbering; source coordinates not silently unified.
Native TbuE ENZRXN11552 has methylcatechol reaction pointer, not exact formal catechol reaction identity.
